_doc: cctvacc: ONE set of CCTV detection thresholds for the phone app (app/lib/shop_motion.dart + guard_box_model.dart -> GuardBoxChannel.kt) and the Shop Box (shopbox/motion_gate.py, shopbox/night.py). Both test suites assert their constants equal this file. Measured by tools/e2e/cctv_accuracy.py (CI).
_doc_pixel: cctvacc2: the phone's second, pixel-level motion check (motion_gate.PixelCheck = shop_motion.dart PixelCheck). diff = the phone's threshold (40: its 80x60 point-sampled plane is noisier than the box's blurred 320-px image; picked on the development sequences of CI run 42672672391 = lowest diff with precision >= 90 on all three sets, reported on that run's held-out sequences); box_diff / learn / scene_frac = the Shop Box pixel path (motion.py MotionDetector defaults).
_doc_detect: cctvdet: zone detections (shopbox/detect_rules.py = app/lib/cctv/detect_rules.dart): person at gate, loitering, post empty, gate open, tamper. 'measured' = precision/recall per detection from the cctv-accuracy CI job (tools/e2e/cctv_accuracy.py --detections); the alert shows that measured precision as its honest confidence.

measured._set: COCO val2017 licensed images, synthetic CCTV scenarios (tools/e2e/cctv_detect_accuracy.py, n=30/kind)
